spec.name: Orange Kitchen Chicken Skewer
spec.description: A slender wooden skewer stacked with three golden grilled chicken pieces, two ivory onion wedges and two juicy red tomato chunks. Stepped ingredient silhouettes, caramelized edges and painted char bands keep the recipe readable at inventory size. The exposed handle rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Chicken Skewer. Thin wooden skewer with alternating individually shaped grilled ingredients and visible char marks. Actual recipe ingredients: chicken, onion, tomato. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
